svg.text: Only manifest CIDs are provider keys
sequential windows for streaming · random windows for background
empty / partial / timeout → split or requeue
wrong tree/proof → peer penalty or ban
consumer observes dataset order while batches may arrive concurrently
Wire frame: uint32 LE length · uint8 type · payload 0x00 Protobuf control · 0x01 WantBlocks request · 0x02 WantBlocks response
Identity chain: manifest CID → tree CID → (index → block CID + Merkle proof) → validated bytes
MIX boundary today: optional private DHT provider lookup through a proxy; manifest and block streams remain direct libp2p protocols
